entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor and regent, Mother of Machines, who rules the Machine Orthodoxy and is shaken by a nightmare cast by Ashiok.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker and nightmare mage who traps Norn in an illusion of a garden of flesh to test whether Phyrexians suit their art.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A human planeswalker who escaped Norn's Basilica; Ashiok found her in Theros's Underworld and uses a nightmare version of her against Norn.

entities.name: Nightmare Elspeth Tirel
aliases: the thing that would be Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A nightmare simulacrum of Elspeth clothed in Norn's porcelain armor, created by Ashiok from the mire; Norn destroys it.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The mechanically altered faithful of the Machine Orthodoxy who unite behind Norn.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The Phyrexian doctrine of unification under machinery and glistening oil that Norn leads.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The holy oil flowing from Norn's body that erases memory and desire and reorders minds.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The organic people of Mirrodin whom the Phyrexians capture and alter.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: Norn's porcelain cathedral-complex on New Phyrexia where the ceremony takes place.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Ashiok first met Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The Underworld of Theros where Ashiok sought Elspeth.

events.summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.
events.quote: "Soon, this wretched human will be released from the burden of fear.

events.summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
events.quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.

events.summary: Norn slays the Mirran with a blade of her porcelain armor and tells the crowd she was too corrupt to save, hiding her own unease.
events.quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

events.summary: Norn returns to the courtyard and finds an organic weed sprouting through the flagstones, which turns out to be a human forearm.
events.quote: Instead, a human forearm dangled, disproportionately large, half-rotten

events.summary: More body-part weeds grow all over the courtyard, and Norn begins to doubt that she herself might be the flaw.
Norn realizes the world is a dream-like illusion and names the planeswalker Ashiok.
Ashiok appears, admits to creating the nightmare as art and testing whether a Phyrexian mind can be afraid.
events.quote: I was not certain Phyrexians would be suitable for my art.

events.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
events.quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

events.summary: Ashiok shapes a nightmare Elspeth in the mirror of Norn's form, which frightens Norn before she slays it.
events.quote: she flung it into the nightmare version of Elspeth Tirel

events.summary: Ashiok flees, the nightmare dissolves and Norn is left shaken by the pity in the false Elspeth's eyes.
events.quote: She looked at Norn with such human pity

events.summary: Norn resolves to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
events.quote: she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

relations.note: Regent and Mother of Machines who rules the Machine Orthodoxy.
relations.quote: Elesh Norn, Phyrexian regent and Mother of Machines

relations.note: Norn is enraged at Ashiok's nightmare and Ashiok treats her as a canvas.
relations.quote: We will not be a tool for your 'art.'
she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

relations.note: Ashiok has inflicted chaos and nightmares on the Mirrans.
relations.quote: the chaos Ashiok had inflicted on the Mirrans
